title: Joseph's Coat
lines: Joseph was the son of Israel, also called Jacob, and Rachel.
約瑟是以色列（也叫雅各）和拉結的兒子。
Israel loved Joseph more than all his other sons.
以色列愛約瑟勝過愛他的其他所有兒子。
In fact, he made Joseph a coat of many colors to show him how much he loved him.
事實上，他為約瑟做了一件彩衣，以表達他有多麼愛他。
When Joseph's brothers saw this, they hated Joseph.
當約瑟的哥哥們看到這個時，他們就恨約瑟。
One night, Joseph had a dream.
有一天晚上，約瑟做了一個夢。
Joseph told his brothers, "Listen to the dream I had."
約瑟對他的哥哥們說：「聽聽我做的這個夢。」
"We were tying up bundles of grain out in the field."
"Your bundles gathered around my bundle and bowed down to it."
「你們的麥捆圍著我的麥捆，向它下拜。」
This made his brothers hate Joseph even more, and they said, "Will you really rule over us?"
這使得他的哥哥們更加恨約瑟，他們說：「難道你真的要統治我們嗎？」
Then Joseph had another dream, and he told his brothers and his father, "I had another dream."
後來約瑟又做了一個夢，他告訴他的哥哥們和父親說：「我又做了一個夢。」
"This time, the sun and moon and 11 stars were bowing down to me."
「這一次，太陽、月亮和十一顆星都在向我下拜。」
This time, Israel heard the dream and rebuked Joseph, saying, "Will we really come and bow down to the ground in front of you?"
這一次，以色列聽見了這個夢就責備約瑟說：「我們難道真的要來俯伏在地向你下拜嗎？」
The brothers were jealous of Joseph.
Israel, however, decided to think about what Joseph had said.
然而，以色列決定好好思考約瑟所說的話。
One day, Joseph's brothers were working when they saw Joseph coming to meet them.
有一天，約瑟的哥哥們正在工作，這時他們看到約瑟來找他們。
One of his brothers said, "Here comes that dreamer."
他的其中一個哥哥說：「那個做夢的來了。」
"Come, let's kill him, then we'll see whether his dreams will come true."
「來吧，我們把他殺了，然後看看他的夢會不會成真。」
Joseph's brother Reuben wanted to save Joseph, so he said, "Let us not take his life."
約瑟的哥哥流便想救約瑟，所以他說：「我們不可要他的命。」
"Throw him into this empty well here in the desert."
「把他丟在這曠野裡的這口空井吧。」
So when Joseph came to his brothers, they attacked him.
所以當約瑟來到他哥哥們那裡時，他們就攻擊了他。
They took the coat their father had given Joseph and threw him into the well.
他們奪走了父親給約瑟的那件彩衣，並把他丟進井裡。
Then they saw a group of men from Midian coming toward them.
接著他們看到一群米甸人朝他們走來。
Judah thought it would be a good idea to sell Joseph to these men.
猶大認為把約瑟賣給這些人是個好主意。
So the brothers sold Joseph to the traders for 20 shekels.
於是哥哥們以二十舍客勒的價錢把約瑟賣給了那些商人。
The brothers then took the coat of many colors back to their father and made him think that Joseph had been killed.
然後哥哥們帶著那件彩衣回到父親那裡，讓他以為約瑟已經被殺了。
Israel wept for his beloved son.
以色列為他心愛的兒子哀哭。
Meanwhile, Joseph was taken as a slave to Egypt to work in the house of a man named Potiphar, one of Pharaoh's officials and the captain of the guard.
同時，約瑟被當作奴隸帶到埃及，在一個名叫波提乏的人家裡工作，這人是法老的臣宰，也是護衛長。
Joseph's story was only just beginning.
